children: First Merchants entered into an Indenture and First Supplemental Indenture to issue $100 million of 6.750% fixed-to-floating rate subordinated notes due 2036. The notes pay 6.750% semi-annually until Oct 1, 2031, then float at Three-Month Term SOFR plus 202 bps, paid quarterly, with maturity on Oct 1, 2036. They are redeemable at par from Oct 1, 2031 on interest payment dates and upon certain regulatory or tax events, subject to any required Federal Reserve approval. The issuance is under an effective shelf registration.
: Indenture and supplemental indenture for subordinated notes offering
: Raise Tier 2 regulatory capital and enhance funding flexibility
